mechanism_narrative: Higher federal funds rates directly reduce equity valuations by increasing the cost of capital, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 20-day forward return is positive in the top 25% of FEDFUNDS observations, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate above 0.2 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 5-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 1 month, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer wealth and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 60-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days as manufacturing slowdowns signal weakening economic activity and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The average 20-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly year-over-year CPI increase above 3.5% signals persistent inflation that prompts restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 60-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A higher unemployment rate level directly reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 5-day forward return is positive in the top 25% of UNRATE observations, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in consumer spending (RSAFS) and residential investment (HOUST) signals broad-based demand weakness that reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The average 20-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining manufacturing output (INDPRO), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 5 trading days as supply chain disruptions dampen corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The average 5-day forward return is positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO declines, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over 3-year windows.
